MLforSEO Academy · The AI-powered Entity Audit

Entity Gap Matrix

Compare your entity coverage against up to three competitors. Names are normalised before anything is compared — the step most gap analyses skip, and the reason most of them are wrong.

What you need
Nothing — no API calls at all
Cost
Free
Feed it
One entity export for you, and one for each competitor
You get back
A shared / missing / unique / thin matrix, exportable as CSV

How to use it

  1. Load your own corpus into the first slot.
  2. Add up to three competitors. Pick them for comparability, not for ranking.
  3. Press Compare, then read the four verdicts.
  4. Filter to missing, and require two or more competitors before you act.
  5. Export, and use it to score Coverage.

Worth knowing. Filter chrome and generic nouns out of every corpus first, not just your own — otherwise the top “gap” will be a word like “content”.
